reason: Conversation 2 immediately asked the sensible first questions (door/drawer closed, food condition), correctly identified the door-ajar temperature alarm, had the user silence it with the alarm button, let it recover, and set a clear 'tell me if it recurs' boundary with no unsupported fault claims or part advice. Conversation 1 misread 'beeping' as a mechanical noise, ran a scripted compressor-noise flow, ignored the customer's explicit mention of the drawer left open and the flashing -9 recovering, and repeatedly insisted the user unplug a working freezer full of food for a pointless back-of-unit inspection. Conversation 1 never reached a diagnosis and risked spoiling food; the only minor flaw in 2 is a slightly short recovery estimate and a dubious remark about alarms wearing on electronics.
